Question 3
?

Let f be a function with f(3)=1,f′(3)=1,f″(3)=2 and f‴(3)=3. Which of the following is the third-degree Taylor polynomial for f about x=3?

a
1+(x−3)+2(x−3)2+3(x−3)3
b
1+(x−3)+(x−3)2+3(x−3)3
c
1+(x−3)+(x−3)2+13(x−3)3
d
1+(x−3)+(x−3)2+12(x−3)3
e
1+(x−3)+2(x−3)2+12(x−3)3
Submit
